# Plan: User Dashboard

## Context
Build a user dashboard that shows account stats, recent activity, and settings.

## Implementation
1. Create a dashboard page at /dashboard (layout per D1)
2. Show user stats (posts, followers, engagement rate) as the stats strip (D1; states D2)
3. Add a recent activity feed (D1; states D2; real-time behavior D8)
4. Add settings at /dashboard/settings instead of a panel on the dashboard (D9)
5. Visual language per D5 (replaces "clean, modern UI with cards and icons")
6. Compact page header per D1 (replaces "hero section with gradient", see Pass 4)

## Technical Details
- React components with Tailwind CSS; D5 tokens are CSS variables mapped into the Tailwind theme
- API endpoint: GET /api/dashboard (per-metric error payloads so D2 partial state is possible)
- WebSocket for real-time activity updates (buffer and reconnect per D8)

## Design Decisions
Surface mode: OPERATE (app UI). Each requirement is specified once here; passes, tasks and report cells cite the ID.

### D1 Information architecture and page header
Attention order: 1) stats strip, 2) activity feed, 3) header wayfinding. Settings live on their own route (D9). No hero. Header holds: logo, h1 "Dashboard", period select (7d / 30d / 90d, default 30d), Settings link. Display name is not in the header; it belongs to the global nav.

Desktop (>=1024px):
```
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Logo]  Dashboard                     [Period: 30d v]  Settings  |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1,248 posts        12,904 followers        4.2% engagement       |
| ^ 3.1% vs prior    ^ 120 vs prior          v 0.4 pt vs prior     |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Recent activity                                     [ 3 new ^ ]  |
| 09:41  ana liked "Launch week"                                   |
| 09:40  sam followed you                                          |
| ...                                                              |
|                      [ Load more ]                               |
+------------------------------------------------------------------+
```
Navigation: /dashboard -> /dashboard/settings; breadcrumb "Dashboard / Settings"; Back restores feed scroll position. Trunk test: logo top-left, h1 names the page, current nav item underlined in accent.

### D4 Component anatomy: stats strip and feed row
Stats strip: three numbers in one row, no cards. Hairline rule above and below. Number 32px tabular mono; label 14px sentence case muted; delta line 14px with direction glyph plus text (never color alone). Feed row: time column (relative, `<time datetime>` with absolute title) and one line of text; actor names truncate at 24 chars with ellipsis and full name in title.

### D2 Interaction states
What the user sees in each state.

| FEATURE | LOADING | EMPTY | ERROR | SUCCESS | PARTIAL |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stats strip | Skeleton bars at final size after a 300ms delay; no layout shift | Numbers read 0 with one line: "Your first post starts the count." + link "Create a post" | "Stats unavailable" + Retry; cached values shown dimmed with "as of 09:12" | Numbers and deltas; delta reads "no prior data" when the prior period is empty | One failed metric shows a dash placeholder in its slot with tooltip "Engagement couldn't load" + Retry; others render |
| Activity feed | 6 skeleton rows at real row height | "Nothing yet. When people follow, like or reply, it shows up here first." + link "Share your profile"; no illustration | "Couldn't load activity." + Retry; section heading stays | Newest first, 20 per page, Load more button | Fewer than 20 items: no Load more; items whose target was deleted read "a post that was removed" |
| Live connection | Not shown | Not shown | After 3 failed reconnects: inline bar "Live updates paused." + Reconnect; auto backoff 1/2/4/8/30s | New items buffered behind the "N new" pill (D8) | Socket down, REST up: feed works, pill hidden, no bar until the 3rd failure |
| Settings form (D9) | Fields disabled with skeleton values | n/a, fields always hold current values | Per-field inline error under the field with icon; focus moves to first error; save failure line "Couldn't save. Your changes are kept." | "Saved" text beside the button for 3s; values persist on reload | Server reports per-field results; failed fields keep their inline error, saved fields clear |

### D3 Journey storyboard
| STEP | USER DOES | USER FEELS | PLAN SPECIFIES? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Opens /dashboard | "Where do I stand?" | Stats first, numbers or skeleton within 300ms (D1, D2) |
| 2 | Scans deltas | Reassured or alerted | Direction glyph plus text vs prior period (D1) |
| 3 | Reads activity | Connected to their audience | Named actors, relative time (D1) |
| 4 | Sees "3 new" | In control, not interrupted | Manual insert pill, no scroll jump (D8) |
| 5 | Loses connection | Mild worry | Paused bar with Reconnect (D2) |
| 6 | Opens settings | Trusts changes stick | Explicit Save, inline confirmation (D9) |
| 7 | New account | Welcomed and nudged | Empty copy with one action (D2) |

Time horizons: 5 seconds, three numbers legible at a glance; 5 minutes, a calm feed with one motion moment (D5); 5 years, three zones and nothing else (subtraction default).

### D5 Visual language and tokens (provisional until DESIGN.md exists, see U1)
- Light by default: use scene is a desk at work in daylight. `prefers-color-scheme: dark` remaps the same tokens.
- No cards, no gradients, no icons in circles, no decorative shadows. The only shadow: period select menu, `0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.08)`.
- Type: IBM Plex Sans for body and UI (explicit Operate-surface assignment); IBM Plex Mono with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` for numbers only. Scale 32/24/18/16/14; body text >= 16px.
- Tokens: `--color-bg #FFFFFF`, `--color-surface #F6F7F9`, `--color-text #16181D`, `--color-text-muted #5B6472`, `--color-accent #0F6E56` (the one accent), `--color-danger #B42318`, `--color-rule #E3E6EB`, `--radius 4px`, space scale 4/8/12/16/24/32/48.
- Browser surfaces: selection accent at 20%, focus ring 2px accent with 2px offset, caret accent, link underline offset 3px, visited links in `--color-text-muted`.
- Motion: one moment. Stats count in from 0 over 400ms ease-out on first load. Pill fades 150ms. Both off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Copy: utility language. No "Welcome back", no "Unlock". Headings: 32px above, 12px below.
- Layout max-width 1040px, left-aligned, never centered text.

### D6 Responsive
| Viewport | Layout |
|---|---|
| >=1024px | D1 diagram. Feed rows two columns: time, text |
| 768 to 1023px | Stats stay one row; deltas drop to a second line under each number. Period select stays in header. Feed full width |
| <=767px (375 target) | Header: h1 plus a labeled settings icon button; period select moves below the h1 at full width. Stats become a vertical list: number left, label and delta right, hairline between rows. "N new" pill sticks under the header. Load more is a 48px full-width button. Feed rows: time above text |

All interactive targets >= 44px on every viewport. Period select is a native `<select>`.

### D7 Accessibility
- Landmarks: `header` (banner), `nav`, `main`; stats as `<section aria-labelledby>`; feed as `<section>` with `<ul>`; one h1.
- Keyboard: skip link, then header, period select, Settings, stats Retry when present, "N new" pill, feed items, Load more. Visible focus ring per D5.
- Screen readers: deltas read "up 3.1 percent versus prior 30 days". Feed region `aria-live="polite"` announces only "3 new activities", not each item. Loading uses `aria-busy`.
- Contrast >= 4.5:1 text, >= 3:1 rules and glyphs. Direction never by color alone.
- Forms (D9): visible labels above fields, errors linked with `aria-describedby`.

### D8 Real-time feed behavior
WebSocket items are buffered. A pill "N new" (99+ cap) appears at the top of the feed; activating it inserts the items at the top with a 150ms fade and preserves scroll position. Items dedupe by id. On reconnect, fetch items since the last seen id over REST, then resume the socket.

### D9 Settings route
/dashboard/settings. Single column, max-width 560px, sections Profile, Notifications, Privacy (field inventory pending, U2). "Save changes" button disabled until dirty; unsaved-changes prompt on navigate away. Destructive actions are out of this plan.

## NOT in scope
- Stat charts: number plus delta covers v1; a chart adds a dependency and a second visual grammar.
- Custom dark-mode art: token remap only.
- Onboarding tour: sizzle in the way; empty states (D2) do the teaching.
- Activity export.

## What already exists
No DESIGN.md was provided. The plan references no existing components. Reuse: Tailwind config as the token host (D5); native `<select>`, `<time>`, `<ul>` over custom widgets; `prefers-*` media queries over JS toggles.

## Design Review (plan-design-review, 2026-10-04)
Run mode: non-interactive at the user's direction. Per-issue AskUserQuestion gates could not fire; remedies D1 to D9 were applied under that instruction and are recorded here rather than individually approved. Mockups: none generated (designer not invoked). Outside voices: skipped.

**Step 0:** 2/10. The plan lists UI nouns and backend details but never says what the user sees first, in what state, at what width. A 10 for this plan: ordered hierarchy, a state table, a journey, tokens, responsive and a11y specs. D1 to D9 supply them. DESIGN.md: none found; run /design-consultation (U1).

**Pass 1 Info Arch:** 2 → 9. Was four unordered items plus a hero. Now D1 orders attention with a diagram and navigation, and D4 fixes the anatomy of the two primary components. To 10: settings inventory (U2).

**Pass 2 States:** 0 → 9. Nothing was specified. D2 covers five states for four features with warm empty copy and one action each. To 10: engagement-rate definition drives zero and delta copy (U3).

**Pass 3 Journey:** 1 → 8. D3 adds seven steps and the three time horizons. To 10: the 5-year layer and power-user differences need product goals this plan does not state.

**Pass 4 AI Slop:** 1 → 9. Classifier: OPERATE. Original hits: hard rejection 7 (app UI as stacked cards), blacklist 1 (gradient), blacklist 3 (icons as decoration), "clean, modern" vibes, hero on an Operate surface. Litmus after fixes: 1 brand unmistakable NO until U1; 2 one anchor YES (stats strip); 3 scan by headlines YES; 4 one job per section YES; 5 cards necessary NO, removed; 6 motion improves YES (one count-in); 7 premium without shadows YES. To 10: palette and typeface are provisional (U1).

**Pass 5 Design System:** 1 → 7. No DESIGN.md. D5 defines explicit tokens and a component vocabulary (header, stats strip, feed row, pill, form). Capped at 7 until tokens are confirmed against a brand (U1).

**Pass 6 Responsive & a11y:** 0 → 9. D6 gives intentional layouts per viewport; D7 covers landmarks, keyboard, screen readers, contrast, reduced motion. To 10: RTL (U4).

**Pass 7 Unresolved decisions** (unscored register):

| DECISION NEEDED | IF DEFERRED, WHAT HAPPENS |
|---|---|
| U1 Brand palette and typeface (no DESIGN.md) | D5 provisional green accent and Plex ship and may clash with the brand |
| U2 Settings field inventory | Engineer invents fields; D9 structure unverifiable |
| U3 Engagement-rate definition and period | Delta and zero-state copy may mislead |
| U4 RTL and localization | Layout does not mirror; relative times hardcoded in English |

**TODOS.md updates:** one proposed, pending disposition (A add / B skip / C build now).
- TODO-1 RTL support (U4). What: mirror D1/D6 layouts and localize D2 copy and times. Why: non-LTR users get a broken reading order. Pros: unlocks those markets. Cons: logical CSS properties and copy extraction across every component. Context: no locale list exists yet. Depends on: product locale decision.
